added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: test_answer_surface_reads_a_section_covering_review and the MCP case at :198 do not fail if plan= is dropped from the callers, so they do not guard the surface change they are named for; with a single stored review, read_plan_review's no-plan branch at reckon/crew/plan_review.py:811 returns that same newest record regardless of coverage — measured at the reviewed head, read_plan_review("sample","fixture", plan=document) and read_plan_review("sample","fixture") both return the record with plan_fingerprint "0"*64. A fixture carrying a newer non-covering record, or an assertion that the whole-document match is absent, is what would make the case discriminate.

follow-on: passing the plan's content narrows the answer verb from the store's newest-review selection to a coverage-requiring selection, so crew review-plan --answer now reports "no stored review" on a plan whose stored review no longer covers it (the plan edited or re-versioned since its review) where it previously returned the newest stored review; the fragment discloses only the "plan path does not resolve" sub-case, not this one.
